Annotators labeled each step as Y (valid), N (invalid), or VND (valid but not deductive) and judged whether a generated premise recovered the missing premise based on entailment relations.

Soundness is defined as whether the abductive inference yields (1) a true new premise (2) that validates in the forward deductive inference. The label set includes Y (valid), N (invalid), VND (valid but not deductive).
